title: Ruthless Bar Salts Orange Fizz On Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Bar Salts Orange Fizz on Ice delivers a lively burst of citrus, blending the bold zest of ripe Oranges with the sparkling essence of fizzy soda. The bright citrus flavour is balanced by a crisp, cooling menthol layer, creating a refreshing vape that captures the sensation of ice-cold orange soda. With a 50VG/50PG blend, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices, providing a satisfying balance of bold flavour and smooth vapour production. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption, making it a go-to choice for fans of citrus-inspired vapes. Ruthless has been at the forefront of e-liquid innovation for years, crafting bold and distinctive flavours that continue to set industry standards. Their nic salt range brings their signature blends into a format designed for modern vaping convenience. Compatible with refillable pod devices or starter vape kits UK , offering easy, reliable vaping every time.
